ValidationRule.description: Check that either perpetual is checked or end date is filled in when agreement goes into effect
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Apttus__Status_Category__c,"In Effect"), AND(ISNULL(Apttus__Contract_End_Date__c),NOT(Apttus__Perpetual__c)), OR(ISNULL(Apttus__Term_Months__c),Apttus__Term_Months__c<=0), APTS_Record_Type_Name__c != "MSSA", APTS_Record_Type_Name__c != "NDA", APTS_Record_Type_Name__c != "DPA", APTS_Record_Type_Name__c != "MPA" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the Agreement End Date or mark the Agreement as Perpetual prior to executing the agreement.
